description: This Java class encodes an HttpResponse object into an HttpServletResponse, mapping status, headers, cookies, and body.

classes.name: MockServerHttpResponseToHttpServletResponseEncoder
classes.description: Encodes HttpResponse objects into HttpServletResponse, setting status, headers, cookies, and body.

methods.name: mapMockServerResponseToHttpServletResponse
methods.description: Maps an HttpResponse to an HttpServletResponse by setting status, headers, cookies, and body.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code and reason phrase on the HttpServletResponse.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers from HttpResponse to HttpServletResponse, excluding certain headers.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Adds cookies from HttpResponse to HttpServletResponse if they do not already exist.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the response.

methods.name: addContentTypeHeader
methods.description: Adds Content-Type header if not already set and if the body has a content type.
